name: Horizontal bar comparison
description: A big condensed uppercase title over a white card with 2-4 horizontal bars. Each row has a mono label on the left and a value on the right that counts up while its bar grows from zero, one row after another; the highlighted bar (the largest by default) is accent, the others ink, then fade to grey so the highlight stands out.
use_when: Lines that compare amounts side by side: this versus that, before versus after, one option against others (time, cost, effort, counts, steps).

title.help: what is compared, e.g. 'Hours per video'; fits on one or two lines

bars.help: 2-4 items [{label, value}]; label up to ~20 characters, value a number

suffix.help: after each value: 1-2 characters sit at full size ('h', '%', 'x'), longer words are set small ('hours')

highlight.help: index of the accent bar (0 = first); defaults to the largest value
